name: Shell
responsibility: The desktop frame in columns: the navigator with the agent dock at its foot, the conversation beside it while open, and the panes
description: No row runs across the frame: each column has its own 40px top row (the brand bar over the navigator, a pane's header, the conversation's header), and the rows line up. The pane centre is the fullscreen root, so presenting a pane never remounts it, and a presented pane gets a slim bar with its exit and the one voice key. The navigator lists every repository with the boards of its chosen checkout under it, says in a repository's row when its checkout is gone or has no vault, and offers a menu of the repository's known checkouts.
